datasets.name: Brazilian E-Commerce Public Dataset by Olist (selected source tables)
datasets.provider: Olist and collaborators; Kaggle dataset record
limitations: Review is associated with an order; only orders with one distinct product ID are retained to avoid review duplication across products.
Source has no human-readable product titles or global IDs; same-model matches to Amazon cannot be made.
Portuguese text is outside the validated language coverage of this project's current English-oriented VADER model.
Ratings are order-level weak satisfaction labels, not human-annotated sentiment ground truth.
CC BY-NC-SA terms apply to data and derivatives; the repository's MIT code license does not replace them.
datasets.attribution: Olist and collaborators. Brazilian E-Commerce Public Dataset by Olist. Kaggle. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/olistbr/brazilian-ecommerce

datasets.name: B2W-Reviews01 product reviews
limitations: Source collection is historical (2018), not current listings or prices.
Portuguese text is not validated for the application English-oriented VADER model.
Ratings and recommendation responses are observed signals, not human-annotated text sentiment.
Product identifiers are internal to Americanas; cross-platform model matching has not been established.
Some review text may concern purchase, payment, or delivery experience.
CC BY-NC-SA conditions apply to corpus and derivatives; repository MIT code license does not replace them.
datasets.attribution: B2W Digital. B2W-Reviews01. Americanas Tech GitHub repository. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. https://github.com/americanas-tech/b2w-reviews01

datasets.name: RePro human-annotated opinion-mining corpus
datasets.provider: RePro authors; sampled from B2W-Reviews01 / Americanas.com
datasets.annotation_method: At least two annotators per sample with expert adjudication; mean sentiment Cohen's kappa 0.71 reported in the paper.
limitations: The released CSV contains 10,003 rows, while the paper reports 10,000; preserve and disclose this discrepancy.
The source sample was stratified by star rating; class proportions are not natural marketplace prevalence estimates.
The three-class evaluation excludes 2,018 mixed-polarity annotations; report this exclusion.
RePro is a subset of B2W-Reviews01 and must not be counted as independent additional review volume.
Current VADER is English-oriented; Portuguese results are cross-language stress measurements, not validated Portuguese model performance.
CC BY-NC-SA conditions apply to this corpus and derivatives; repository MIT code license does not replace them.
datasets.attribution: dos Santos Silva et al. (2024). RePro: a benchmark for Opinion Mining for Brazilian Portuguese. PROPOR, pp. 432-440. Credit B2W Digital as required by the dataset notice. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. https://github.com/lucasnil/repro

datasets.name: Virtual Assistant Devices Dataset
datasets.provider: Yaser Alhasawi and Salem Alghamdi; Mendeley Data
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 (as stated by the Mendeley dataset record)
datasets.rights_status: Mendeley dataset record lists CC BY 4.0. The associated paper reports that platform redistribution policies were followed.
datasets.use_policy: Keep separate from the main Amazon corpus. Do not use as a gold evaluation set until the source label-count discrepancy is resolved. Attribute authors and dataset; identify project normalization.
limitations: The downloaded spreadsheet label totals disagree with the paper and dataset record (negative 774 vs 800; neutral 754 vs 728).
No numeric star ratings or review dates are present.
Only five of ten device models have reviews from more than one retailer; cross-retailer sample sizes are uneven.
Historical collection (2018–2023); not live reviews or current prices.
datasets.attribution: Alhasawi, Yaser; Alghamdi, Salem (2023), Virtual Assistant Devices Dataset, Mendeley Data, V1, DOI: 10.17632/d5vsgcxrk5.1, CC BY 4.0.

datasets.name: BanglaEcomReviewCorpus: A Resource for E-Commerce Product Review Sentiment Analysis
datasets.provider: Umme Ayman, Taslima Akter, Md. Tanvir Ahmed Akash, and Saiham Zaman Mridul; Mendeley Data
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 (as stated by the Mendeley dataset record and open-access article)
datasets.language: Bangla; source file also provides English translations
datasets.rights_status: Mendeley dataset record lists CC BY 4.0; associated data article is open access under CC BY.
datasets.use_policy: Use as a separate Bangla sentiment benchmark with attribution. Do not use for platform comparisons or matched-product analysis because row-level platform and product identifiers are absent.
limitations: Marketplace sources are described at corpus level only, not per review row.
No product name or product identifier is included.
English translation method is not sufficiently documented to treat translations as English gold data.
Use a Bangla-capable model; VADER scores on original Bangla are not valid evidence.
datasets.attribution: Ayman, Umme; Akter, Taslima; Akash, Md. Tanvir Ahmed; Mridul, Saiham Zaman (2025), BanglaEcomReviewCorpus: A Resource for E-Commerce Product Review Sentiment Analysis, Mendeley Data, V2, DOI: 10.17632/kkzfrvhbhp.2, CC BY 4.0.

not_included: No dataset with reviews of the same identified product model across multiple retailers is included. Public candidates and pending rights checks are documented in research/cross_platform_data_clearance.md.
The Olist supplementary corpus is separate from and not loaded into the main application database.
RePro is an annotated subset of B2W-Reviews01, not an independent additional review corpus; its 3-class benchmark excludes mixed labels.
No authorized Flipkart, Myntra, Meesho, Daraz, or Pickaboo review corpus is included.
Amazon Reviews 2023 files and this derived database are not committed to the repository.
